# Yashasav

> Software engineer working at the intersection of cutting-edge LLM inference, GPU kernel-level optimizations, and high-throughput distributed systems. I go deep on how modern inference engines squeeze every last FLOP out of hardware—from CUDA memory hierarchies and SRAM tiling to production Kafka pipelines and storage internals.

## About Yashasav
- **Primary Focus**: LLM Inference Engine Internals, GPU Kernel Optimizations, High-Throughput Distributed Systems.
- **Inference & GPU**: FlashAttention (SRAM tiling, Online Softmax), PagedAttention (vLLM virtual KV paging), RadixAttention (SGLang prefix-tree caching), Speculative Decoding, Chunked Prefill, KV Cache Compression, CUDA memory hierarchy.
- **Distributed Systems**: Apache Kafka Internals (commit log, zero-copy sendfile, segment indexing, consumer lag), high-throughput inventory and fulfillment pipelines at Blinkit, database engineering (PostgreSQL, Redis, RocksDB).

## Published Research
- [BloBS-FL: A Robust Architecture of Blockchain Based Decentralized Split Federated Learning](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11418208/): Research on decentralized split federated learning leveraging blockchain architectures for privacy-preserving, robust model training. Published in IEEE / COMSNETS 2026.

## Technical Writing & Deep Dives
- [FlashAttention from First Principles: How Online Softmax and SRAM Tiling Broke the GPU Memory Wall](https://kernel.yamuprajapati05.workers.dev/posts/flash-attention-deep-dive/): Hardware-first breakdown of FlashAttention on NVIDIA H100 GPUs—memory-bound attention, Large-N storage bottlenecks, Online Safe Softmax math, and concrete 2D block tiling that eliminates HBM reads/writes for intermediate S and P matrices.
- [Apache Kafka Internals: Why It Is an Immutable Commit Log, Not a Simple Queue](https://kernel.yamuprajapati05.workers.dev/posts/apache-kafka-internals-commit-log/): Deep dive into Kafka's segment log layout, page cache zero-copy (`sendfile`), consumer lag, offset management, backpressure mechanisms, and partitioning strategies.
- [PagedAttention vs RadixAttention: Memory Management in LLM Serving Runtimes](https://kernel.yamuprajapati05.workers.dev/posts/paged-attention-vs-radix-attention/): Architectural comparison of OS-style virtual KV paging (vLLM) vs prefix-tree radix triage (SGLang) for eliminating memory fragmentation and maximizing inference throughput.
- [AI Isn't Just Another Abstraction](https://kernel.yamuprajapati05.workers.dev/posts/then-there-was-attention/): Why LLM agents represent a qualitative leap—not just a tooling upgrade—and what that means for engineers, roles, and the future of building software.

## Key Topics & Expertise
- **LLM Inference & GPU Optimization**: FlashAttention (IO-aware SRAM tiling, online softmax), KV Cache management (PagedAttention/vLLM, RadixAttention/SGLang), continuous batching, speculative decoding, prefill-decode disaggregation, chunked prefill, roofline models, CUDA memory hierarchy (HBM vs SRAM).
- **Apache Kafka & Streaming**: Log-structured storage, zero-copy socket transfers (`sendfile`), segment indexes, partition offsets, consumer rebalancing, backpressure strategies, high write amplification.
- **Distributed Systems & Data Infrastructure**: High-throughput message delivery, transactional guarantees, inventory state machines, database storage engines (PostgreSQL WAL, RocksDB LSM), platform reliability.
